description: Cyber-insurance posture for a whole SonicWall fleet: firmware, advisories, MFA, SSL-VPN exposure and licences, one row per firewall.
auth_description: Run `sonicwall-pp-cli nsm-login` with SONICWALL_MSW_API_KEY set; it mints the NSM token from your MySonicWall API key and saves it.

novel_features.name: Insurance posture report
novel_features.description: One row per firewall with firmware currency, end-of-support date, published advisories, soonest licence expiry, admin TOTP, SSL-VPN exposure and SSL-VPN users without one-time passwords; each check is pass, warn, fail or unknown, and the licence check needs SONICWALL_MSW_API_KEY.

novel_features.name: Advisory exposure triage
novel_features.description: Rank the SonicWall PSIRT advisories NSM matched to your fleet, or name one advisory (SNWLID ID) to list every affected firewall and whether SSL-VPN is enabled on an internet-facing zone (security type untrusted, or a name containing WAN); a CVE ID only matches when NSM's advisory text names it.

novel_features.name: Firmware drift
novel_features.description: See how far each firewall's running SonicOS build is behind the newest available build and which advisories the upgrade clears.

novel_features.name: Licence renewals list
novel_features.description: Every licence and security service expiring in the next N days (expired ones included), per firewall and client, flagged when the hardware is near end of support; needs SONICWALL_MSW_API_KEY.

novel_features.name: MFA audit
novel_features.description: Per-account remediation list: admin TOTP per firewall and every local SSL-VPN user (direct or nested group member) without a one-time password, with SAML, RADIUS, LDAP or TACACS+ sign-in marked as delegated.

novel_features.name: NSM blind spots
novel_features.description: Find firewalls registered in MySonicWall that NSM cannot see, with their registered firmware's advisories and support expiry; needs SONICWALL_MSW_API_KEY and an NSM token.

novel_features.name: Posture change log
novel_features.description: What changed in fleet posture between saved posture runs of the same scope: newly vulnerable, MFA turned off, SSL-VPN newly on WAN, licence lapsed, firmware fixed. Local only: run posture now and again later, with the same SONICWALL_MSW_API_KEY and NSM tenant.
